## Three Ways Through the Course

| Route | Use it when | Before the capstone | Estimated active effort* |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Core** | You want the shortest coherent learning path | Complete each day’s core “Read + Do + Check” work and evidence checkpoints | 16–24 hours |
| **Full bootcamp** | You want the breadth of the original workshop | Add all recordings, activities, optional technical deep dives, and relevant installations | 35–55 hours |
| **Reference** | You already have a workflow or a specific question | Jump by tool, concept, or target; follow the prerequisites named on that page | Variable |

*Downloads, scheduler queues, and GPU runtime are additional. [Compare the routes, prerequisites, and compute options in Start Here →](start-here.qmd)

## Getting Started

1. Read **[Start Here](start-here.qmd)** and choose the core, full-bootcamp, or reference route.
2. Create the evidence-portfolio folders and record your compute/account fallback.
3. Start with **[Monday’s readiness checks](monday/index.qmd#pre-work-and-readiness)** unless your environment is already verified.
4. Move through the historical days in order when possible; later activities assume earlier concepts even when they use a different tool.
5. Check a progress item only after its named log, structure, figure, comparison, or decision memo exists.
6. Return anytime and use the resume banner to pick up where you left off.
